metadata.title: Public Water Service Lines
metadata.description: A water service pipe, also known as a water service line, is the way drinking water is delivered to each home in Calgary. The water service pipe can be thought of as two sections: (1) From the water main to the property line: This part of the pipe is owned and maintained by The City of Calgary. (2) From the property line to your house: This part of the pipe is owned and maintained by the homeowner. The data shown here only relates to the portion of the water service pipe on public property, owned and operated by The City. The material on private property can be a different material, and could have been installed at a different time. The data shown on this map is subject to change due to parcel re-development or The City repair/maintenance activities. If you believe there is an error or an omission regarding to the pipe material provided on this map, please contact 311. For more information, please visit: Water Service Lines in Calgary

scope.method: Source geometries intersect original official community polygons. Boundary-crossing assets can belong to multiple communities.

metadata.outputFormat: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; original geometry field moved to feature.geometry; source number columns converted from numeric strings to JSON numbers.

observedPeriod.meaning: Recorded installation dates, not inspection/condition dates.

limits: Only the public portion of the service connection is described. Private-side pipes and interior plumbing can use different materials and installation dates.
Unknown material values remain Unknown; building age does not establish Poly-B or lead presence.
Dates are preserved as supplied; 1899/1900 dates may be incomplete/default records and should not be treated as verified pipe age without confirmation.
metadata.featureId: Generated local identifier from record content hash and duplicate occurrence; not a City asset identifier.
